# NxCode

> > NxCode is an AI-powered multi-agent platform for building production-ready web and mobile applications in minutes, featuring NxCode Studio, marketplace monetization, and support for React Native, Docker, and modern web technologies.

NxCode enables rapid application development through AI-driven workflows, from concept to deployment. The platform includes NxCode Studio for app creation, a marketplace for monetizing templates and apps, and comprehensive tutorials covering SaaS, mobile, e-commerce, and real-time applications with technologies like Conductor, Virtuoso, Stripe, and Cloudflare.

## Key Topics

- NxCode Studio
- AI-powered app development
- React Native mobile apps
- No-code/low-code platform
- App monetization & marketplace
- Conductor & Virtuoso frameworks
- Docker containerization
- Multi-tenant SaaS applications
- Stripe payment integration
- iOS & Android development
- Cloudflare deployment
- WebSocket real-time features
- Template business model
- Revenue sharing
- Rapid prototyping

## Core Platform

- [NxCode Studio: Build Production-Ready Apps in Minutes](https://www.nxcode.io/ar/studio): NxCode Studio main product page - AI-powered multi-agent app builder
- [NxCode Studio (Dutch)](https://www.nxcode.io/nl/studio): NxCode Studio product page - rapid AI-powered app development platform
- [NxCode Studio (Swedish)](https://www.nxcode.io/sv/studio): Swedish Studio page - multi-agent AI development from concept to deploy
- [NxCode Homepage (German)](https://www.nxcode.io/de): German homepage - AI app builder with login, chat, admin panel integration
- [NxCode Homepage (Korean)](https://www.nxcode.io/ko): Korean homepage - AI-powered app/web builder with one-click deploy
- [NxCode Pricing (Norwegian)](https://www.nxcode.io/no/pricing): Pricing plans: Free start, $5/mo (200 credits), $20/mo Pro with 2x bonus
- [Bibe - Interactive AI Coding Education](https://www.nxcode.io/et/bibe): Bibe - gamified AI coding education platform, build apps in 3 minutes

## Web Application Development

- [Build a SaaS Web App](https://www.nxcode.io/tutorials/web-applications): Build SaaS app with Conductor+Virtuoso, Docker, multi-tenant & Cloudflare
- [Real-Time Dashboard Application](https://www.nxcode.io/zh-TW/tutorials/realtime-dashboard): Build data dashboard with WebSocket live updates & interactive charts

## Mobile Application Development

- [Cross-Platform Mobile App with React Native](https://www.nxcode.io/he/tutorials/react-native-app): Build iOS/Android apps from single React Native codebase with Expo
- [Build a Mobile App (Norwegian)](https://www.nxcode.io/no/tutorials/mobile-applications): iOS/Android apps with React Native, Docker testing & app store deploy
- [Mobile E-commerce with Payments](https://www.nxcode.io/it/tutorials/mobile-ecommerce): Shopping app with Apple Pay/Google Pay integration & order tracking

## Marketplace & Monetization

- [Publishing Your First App](https://www.nxcode.io/pt/tutorials/publishing-first-app): Submit apps to NxCode marketplace with pricing & monetization guide
- [Publishing Your First App (Japanese)](https://www.nxcode.io/ja/tutorials/publishing-first-app): Japanese guide: submit apps to NxCode marketplace with revenue share
- [Publishing Your First App (Korean)](https://www.nxcode.io/ko/tutorials/publishing-first-app): Korean tutorial: marketplace submission, pricing models & review process
- [Building a Template Business](https://www.nxcode.io/id/tutorials/template-business): Create & sell reusable templates for recurring revenue on marketplace
- [Optimizing for Sales](https://www.nxcode.io/id/tutorials/optimizing-sales): Optimize app listings: descriptions, screenshots, pricing & conversions
